easy.text: The cat sat on the mat and watched the rain fall down the glass. A small bird flew by the window and sang a quiet song to the sky.

The sun went down behind the hill. The sky turned pink and gold and the first star came out above the lake near our home.

medium.text: Typing fast is a skill that grows with steady practice. Pay attention to your fingers, keep them on the home row, and try to look ahead at the next few words rather than the key under your hand.

A good keyboard, a quiet room, and a relaxed wrist can do wonders for your speed. Most people improve faster when they focus on accuracy first and let the speed climb on its own over many short sessions.

hard.text: Quantum mechanics, despite its mathematical elegance, often produces results that feel deeply counterintuitive to the human mind, suggesting that our everyday assumptions about determinism, locality, and the nature of reality itself may be incomplete or fundamentally mistaken.
